title: 沙漠电台的奇怪音乐会

story.title_zh: 沙漠电台的奇怪音乐会

scenes.title: The Gold Card
scenes.en: On one dry afternoon, Mia finds an unusual card in front of the bookshelf. It says, “Welcome to the Desert Concert. Choose your transport in the app!”
scenes.zh: 一个干燥的下午，米娅在书架前发现一张不寻常的卡片。上面邀请她选择交通工具去参加沙漠音乐会。

image.alt: 米娅在书架前发现一张金色音乐会卡片，爸爸和小狗一起查看。
image.caption: On one dry afternoon, Mia finds an unusual card in front of the bookshelf. It says, “Welcome to the Desert Concert. Choose your transport in the app!”

Primary request: At home in a cosy living room, Mia, an East Asian girl about 9 in a coral-orange jacket, finds an elegant blank gold-edged desert concert card on the floor in front of a large bookshelf. Her father in a teal overshirt and their golden retriever with a blue collar lean in with surprise. A phone beside them shows simple map and transport app icons without text.

question.answer_en: She finds an unusual gold card.
question.answer_zh: 她发现了一张不寻常的金色卡片。

scenes.title: The Flat Tyre
scenes.en: Mia and Dad drive through the forest. Their dog follows the blue car. Then the tyre goes flat beside a box of wood. “You seem worried. What should happen now?” asks Dad.
scenes.zh: 米娅和爸爸开车穿过森林，小狗跟着蓝色汽车。轮胎却在一箱木头旁瘪了。爸爸问：“你看起来很担心。现在该怎么办？”

image.alt: 森林路边的蓝色汽车爆胎了，米娅、爸爸和小狗停下来想办法。
image.caption: Mia and Dad drive through the forest. Their dog follows the blue car. Then the tyre goes flat beside a box of wood. “You seem worried. What should happen now?” asks Dad.

scenes.title: The Worst Soup
scenes.en: They camp near the desert. Dad says, “Let’s boil water,” and adds a red chilli. Mia cuts a slice of bread and drops one piece into the pot. “Worst soup ever!” she laughs.
scenes.zh: 他们在沙漠附近露营。爸爸烧水并放入一根辣椒，米娅又把一片面包的一小块掉进锅里。她笑着说：“史上最糟的汤！”

image.alt: 沙漠边的营地里，爸爸烧水，米娅拿着辣椒和面包片做怪汤。

question.en: Why does Mia call it the worst soup?
question.zh: 米娅为什么称它为最糟的汤？
question.answer_en: It has chilli and a piece of bread in it.
question.answer_zh: 汤里有辣椒和一块面包。

scenes.title: The Secret Stage
scenes.en: At sunset, the radio says, “Cross the dry river and look through the gold curtain.” Behind it, an art stage shines under rich golden lights.
scenes.zh: 日落时，收音机让他们穿过干涸的河床，再从金色幕布向里看。幕布后，美术舞台在浓郁的金光下闪亮。

image.alt: 日落时，米娅带着收音机穿过干河床，前方金色幕布后藏着美术舞台。
image.caption: At sunset, the radio says, “Cross the dry river and look through the gold curtain.” Behind it, an art stage shines under rich golden lights.

question.en: What is behind the gold curtain?

scenes.title: The Living Room Shop
scenes.en: Inside the living room set, a printer makes a page with a discount. Mia pays cash for soap, tights, an eraser and a small ball. “This seat is mine,” she says.
scenes.zh: 在客厅布景里，打印机打出一张折扣页。米娅用现金买了肥皂、连裤袜、橡皮和小球，又指着座位说：“这是我的。”

image.alt: 音乐厅的客厅商店里有书架、打印机和多种小物品，米娅用现金购物。

scenes.title: The Unusual Concert
scenes.en: The concert begins. Musicians tap a bathtub and shake a box. The dog dances. “This is an interesting example of music!” says Mia. Everyone gets a gold welcome card.
scenes.zh: 音乐会开始了。音乐家敲浴缸、摇箱子，小狗跳起舞。米娅说：“这真是有趣的音乐例子！”每个人都得到一张金色欢迎卡。

image.alt: 奇怪的沙漠音乐会上，音乐家敲浴缸和木箱，小狗在金色舞台中央跳舞。

question.en: What unusual instruments do the musicians use?
question.zh: 音乐家用了哪些不寻常的乐器？
